reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because its presenter promotes the OneCoin Infinity Trader package with claims that Infinity+ can significantly increase tokens and coins, while soliciting viewers to bank codes for a free-code reward. It also connects CoinSafe deposit rates and gains attributed to rising currency values with further information about the offering, alongside a Cloud Plus purchase incentive, although the records do not establish prices, complete terms, completed transactions, or resulting value.

citations.quote: If you choose the Infinity Plus option within the package you'll get up to seven splits and will be able to significantly increase your tokens and in turn, your coins.
coinSafes gives you the chance to also earn a deposit rate on the balance of your coins besides what you earn from the rising value of the oneCoin currency.
If you bank 8 codes, you'll get one free Infinity Code.

opening.argument: The presentation does not state that returns are guaranteed, that viewers will profit, or that any purchase is risk-free. Its language describes package features and opportunities, while the available record gives no completed transaction, outcome, or proof that the speaker promises a result. Even the most pointed wording says Infinity+ can provide up to seven splits and increase tokens and coins, not that this outcome is certain. The CoinSafe statement likewise describes a chance to earn a deposit rate, rather than an unconditional return. A careful reading therefore supports ordinary promotional speech whose risks and terms require independent evaluation, not a demonstrated deceptive guarantee.

citations.quote: If you choose the Infinity Plus option within the package you'll get up to seven splits and will be able to significantly increase your tokens and in turn, your coins.
coinSafes gives you the chance to also earn a deposit rate on the balance of your coins besides what you earn from the rising value of the oneCoin currency.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited package language is promotional, but it does not establish a guaranteed return or prove that the offer was deceptive. “Up to” describes a limit, and “will be able” describes an advertised capability, not a promised financial outcome. The deposit-rate statement says “chance,” while the record supplies no terms, transaction, or result. The code reward likewise shows an offer condition, not an investment guarantee.

citations.quote: you'll get up to seven splits
gives you the chance to also earn a deposit rate
If you bank 8 codes, you'll get one free Infinity Code.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The wording is still a direct sales pitch for a package tied to token and coin increases. “Up to” limits the number of splits but does not remove the claimed mechanism; “will be able to significantly increase” presents appreciation as an expected benefit. The deposit-rate statement expressly combines earnings with a rising currency value. No disclaimer, risk warning, or uncertainty about loss appears in these supplied passages.

opening.argument: The format is a recurring State of the Nation broadcast that reports product updates, software features, webinars, events, and organizational news. The speaker explains that OneCoin Cloud is available for Windows, OS X, Android, and iOS and describes storage, encryption, browser, and VPN functionality. He also directs viewers to other videos and a website for more information. That is consistent with an informational product presentation and company update, not proof that the entire video is a financial solicitation. The record does not show a purchase flow, a completed sale, or a demonstrated financial result.

citations.quote: This increase comes following the recent improvements and upgrades to packages which you can download for Windows, OS X, Android, and iOS from our website.
it gives you an astounding 100 gigabytes of encrypted and storage, client side encryption with zero knowledge privacy, a highly secured browser, and a VPN connection for a year.
Go to our Youtube videos and learn more.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the broadcast a company update does not turn its explicit offers into a tutorial or demonstration. The same program presents the Infinity Trader package, token increases, CoinSafe earnings, and code-based rewards. The Cloud discussion and links are additional material; they do not erase the financial promotion that the opening identifies.

citations.quote: OneCoin is offering you an exceptional opportunity, the Infinity Trader package.
coinSafes gives you the chance to also earn a deposit rate

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The broadcast format and technical details are incidental to the central offer. The speaker does not merely explain how encryption or a VPN works; he recommends a paid Cloud option and adds tokens, while the same episode promotes a package whose advertised benefit is increasing tokens and coins. Directing viewers to more videos and a website reinforces promotion rather than neutral instruction.

citations.quote: Most members opt to purchase the best option the OneCoin Cloud Plus which we would also recommend
significantly increase your tokens and in turn, your coins
Visit our website now to find out more about the unique OneCoin Cloud offers

opening.argument: The concrete structure shown is ordinary commerce and promotional rewards: packages are offered, software services are described, and bonus codes are offered when specified numbers of codes are banked. The material does not show a request for passwords, credentials, or personal deposits, nor does it establish a downline-income scheme, a guaranteed payout, or a completed transaction. The Cloud offer even identifies conventional service features such as encrypted storage, a browser, and a VPN. Without the missing mechanism and terms, the evidence supports a product-and-promotion classification rather than a scam finding.

citations.quote: More and more people are taking advantage of the unique cloud-based offer for users who are looking for a storage solution with client-side encryption functionality.
it gives you an astounding 100 gigabytes of encrypted and storage, client side encryption with zero knowledge privacy, a highly secured browser, and a VPN connection for a year.
if you bank 10 premium codes you'll get one premium code free

rebuttal.rebuttal: The absence of a password request or completed transaction is not decisive when the supplied evidence directly describes purchasing packages and banking codes for additional codes. Ordinary commerce can still be used to promote a financial opportunity. More importantly, the presentation connects CoinSafe earnings to coin balances and a rising currency value, so the evidence is not limited to a storage-service discount.

citations.quote: earn a deposit rate on the balance of your coins besides what you earn from the rising value
If you choose the Infinity Plus option within the package
if you bank 10 premium codes you'll get one premium code free

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The service features and bonus-code mechanics do not make the financial claims ordinary retail. The Infinity offer is a package whose stated effect is to increase tokens and coins, and CoinSafe adds a deposit rate to gains from a rising currency. Those are return-linked representations, not merely a discount on storage. A missing credential request cannot negate what the speaker actually says about financial benefits.
